results.explanation: The declared entry authenticates the caller as a verified user and, for a non-admin, restricts retrieval of the source file to that user's file ID. It does not perform a target-specific authorization check on the caller-supplied collection_name. When collection_name is supplied, that value is passed unchanged to save_docs_to_vector_db, whose visible sink inserts the generated items into VECTOR_DB_CLIENT using collection_name. Thus a verified non-admin who owns the source file can cause its content to be written to an existing destination collection despite lacking destination write permission. This supports the stated policy failure; the fixed crop does not establish repository-wide completeness.
